description.value: Chatterbox Cafe is the on-site cafe at the Britannia Mine Museum in Britannia Beach, a historic stop on the Sea to Sky Highway between Vancouver and Whistler. It serves freshly brewed coffees, espresso, hearty soups, gourmet sandwiches, and grab-and-go snacks in a cozy, historic setting adjacent to the museum's Guest Services and Company Store. The cafe doubles as a mini film-history exhibit, displaying autographed photos from productions shot at the museum site including The X-Files, Supernatural, and The Flash.
